verified_claims.claim: 10 个新化合物 oxaleimides A–J (1–10) 被表征为新天然产物；1、2、3 为含双取代琥珀酰亚胺骨架的最丰产成员
verified_claims.evidence: Each of the 10 compounds were characterized to be new natural products. The most abundant compounds, oxaleimides A (1), B (2), and C (3), all contain an unusual disubstituted succinimide moiety.

verified_claims.claim: 9 对 HeLa 细胞 IC50 = 0.32 μM；3、10 IC50 ≈ 4.0 μM；1、2 无活性
verified_claims.evidence: Whereas 1 and 2 exhibited no activity, maleimide 9 displayed cytotoxicity with an IC50 of 0.32 μM. Compounds 3 and 10 showed weaker toxicity with IC50 values of ∼4.0 μM (Figure S8).

verified_claims.claim: C7 绝对构型通过 (R)/(S)-PGME 衍生化 (11a/11b) 及 11a X-ray 单晶衍射确定为 R
verified_claims.evidence: the carboxylate group was converted into (R)- and (S)-PGME amides (11a and 11b), which allowed assignment of the absolute configuration at C7 to be R (Figure S7). This stereochemistry was further confirmed by X-ray crystal structure analysis of 11a (Figure 2C).

verified_claims.claim: C18 取代基为聚酮起源，末端双键来自一整段[1,2-13C2]-acetate，提示存在碳骨架重排
verified_claims.evidence: The labeling studies showed that the substituent at C18 is of polyketide origin. Notably, the terminal olefin is derived from one intact unit of acetate, suggesting that a carbon skeletal rearrangement is required in the biosynthesis of 1.

verified_claims.claim: ΔpoxO 积累化合物 12 (trans-decalin 醇)；14 (S,E)-2-aminodec-4-enoic acid 化学合成自 N-Fmoc-(L)-allylglycine；ΔpoxF 中添加 14 几乎完全恢复 1–10 合成
verified_claims.evidence: we isolated a new compound 12 upon knockout of the α/β-hydrolase poxO... we chemically synthesized 14 using a two-step metathesis, deprotection reaction sequence from N-Fmoc-(L)-allylglycine and supplemented it to either the ΔpoxE or ΔpoxF mutant. Whereas no oxaleimide production was restored in the former, addition of 14 led to near complete restoration of oxaleimide production in ΔpoxF (Figure 2F, iii).

verified_claims.claim: A. nidulans 异源表达梯度证实 PoxF (HRPKS) → PoxM (P450) → PoxL (aminotransferase) 三酶接力；仅 poxF 无产物，p poxF+poxM 得 15 与 16，加入 poxL 得 14
verified_claims.evidence: Expressing the HRPKS alone did not yield any detectable product (Figure 2E, ii), while expressing PoxF and PoxM led to the formation of two new products: 2-hydroxydec-4-enoic acid (15) and 2-oxodec-4-enoic acid (16) (Figure 2E, iii). Further addition of the aminotransferase PoxL led to production of 14 (Figure 2E, iv and v).

verified_claims.claim: PoxL 体外酶活证实以天冬氨酸为最优氨基供体还原胺化 16 → 14；饱和 2-aminodecanoic acid 喂养 ΔpoxE 不能恢复 1–10，证明双键是必需
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.3 右栏 / p.4 左栏
verified_claims.evidence: The role of the PoxL was verified in an enzyme assay during which 16 was reductively aminated to 14 using aspartic acid as the optimal amine donor (Figure S10)... The internal olefin is essential, as feeding of the saturated 2-aminodecanoic acid to P. oxalicum ΔpoxE did not restore biosynthesis of 1−10.
